entry.title: Derivations utilized in our recent paper

entry.content:
Derivations used in our recent paper on villi-pumped efficiency and energetics.

Stokes second problem

Problem concerns an oscillating (with circular frequency \(\omega\)) flat-plate bounding a semi-infinite fluid of dynamic viscosity \(\mu\). The problem is described here.

Derivation for the total viscous dissipation over flat-plate length \(P\) (PDF).

Long-wavelength peristaltis derivation

Problem concerns flow generared by propagating peristaltic wave moving along the walls of a thin 2D channel. The solution is obtained in (Shapiro, Jaffrin & Weinberg 1969).

The solution is derived using the same notation as in Shapiro et. al. (1969) (PDF).

Derivation for the wall-shear and channel vorticity scales for a peristaltic wavelength of \(\lambda\).
entry.summary: Energetics, shearing and pumping efficiency of propagating contractions over villi-patterned wall
